hero.title: KAILASH PARBAT: A Legacy of Pure Vegetarian Culinary Excellence
hero.subtitle: Savour the authentic tastes of North Indian & Sindhi cuisine, crafted with 70+ years of passion and tradition. From iconic chaats to rich gravies, every dish is a celebration at Kailash Parbat.

about.title: The Timeless Story of KAILASH PARBAT
about.paragraph1: Started in the 1950s by the visionary Mulchandani brothers, KAILASH PARBAT stands as one of the most iconic brands in the Indian restaurant sector. Specializing in ethnic, pure vegetarian North Indian and Sindhi cuisine, the Kailash Parbat Group proudly operates 70 units under various esteemed brands.
about.paragraph2: With a remarkable legacy spanning over 70 years, KAILASH PARBAT has become synonymous with unparalleled customer delight. We are celebrated for our authentic North Indian delicacies, particularly our renowned chaats and exquisite gravies, continuing to bring a rich heritage of flavour to every table.
